convention.name: United Nations — Genocide Convention, Article II

croatia.name: International Court of Justice — Summary of judgment, 3 February 2015
croatia.limitations: Finding concerns the evidence and parties in that case, not Gaza.

expulsion.name: International Court of Justice — Croatia v. Serbia, 2015 judgment

group.name: International Court of Justice — Summary of order, 26 January 2024

interim.name: International Court of Justice — Order of 26 January 2024

jelisic.name: International tribunal — Jelisić appeal judgment, 5 July 2001
jelisic.limitations: The appeal concerns an individual; do not turn every military objective into a personal motive or treat mixed intent as proved.

state.name: International Law Commission — Articles on State Responsibility
state.limitations: Attribution of conduct does not itself establish genocidal intent.

targeting.name: ICRC — Targeting under international humanitarian law
targeting.limitations: Not a factual finding about any particular Gaza attack.

shields.name: International Committee of the Red Cross — How humanitarian law applies in Israel and the occupied territories
shields.locator: Continuing obligations of the attacking party

srebrenica.name: International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia — Krstić appeal summary
srebrenica.locator: Krstić appeal, group destruction and targeting of men

rwanda.name: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum — The Rwanda genocide
rwanda.locator: Civil war and genocide against Tutsi civilians

croatia_result.name: International Court of Justice — Croatia v. Serbia case overview

kosovo.name: International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia — Kosovo judgment summary, 26 February 2009
kosovo.locator: Judgment summary: common purpose and convictions

ministry.name: Associated Press — How Gaza’s Health Ministry calculates the death toll
ministry.locator: Medical and registration records within Hamas-run administration
ministry.limitations: Institutional affiliation does not authenticate or discredit every individual record.

combatants.name: Associated Press — Gaza school strike report, 3 April 2025
combatants.locator: Israeli claim of around 20,000 militants killed
combatants.basis: Secondary synthesis of competing official claims
combatants.limitations: No independently verified civilian-combatant ratio; do not subtract incompatible estimates as if both were audited.

verified.name: Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights — Six-month Gaza report, November 2024
verified.limitations: Case verification is not a random sample; sources can overlap with ministry records.

capture.name: Jamaluddine and colleagues — Traumatic injury mortality, The Lancet, 2025
capture.locator: Methods and estimated traumatic deaths to 30 June 2024
capture.limitations: Model depends on overlapping lists, including ministry inputs; no combatant classification.

survey.name: Spagat and colleagues — Population-representative Gaza mortality survey, The Lancet Global Health, 2026
survey.locator: Methods and findings of survey conducted 30 December 2024–5 January 2025
survey.limitations: Accessible-area household sampling with displaced populations representing inaccessible governorates; raking uses official demographic frames. Separate from ministry death enumeration, not independent of every official input. Recall and missing or entirely lost households remain limitations.
survey.verification_note: Publisher and PubMed indexed abstracts rechecked on 17 October 2026 and agree on the tested estimate and interval. A correction notice exists; no question tests the corrected supervision detail or appendix.

projection.name: Khatib, McKee and Yusuf — Counting the dead in Gaza, The Lancet correspondence, 2024

siege.name: International Court of Justice — Order of 26 January 2024, recorded official statements
siege.locator: Order of 26 January 2024: recorded announcement of 9 October 2023

water.name: Human Rights Watch — Extermination and Acts of Genocide, December 2024
water.locator: Summary, policy mechanisms, imagery and water access
water.limitations: Human Rights Watch investigation; legal conclusions attributed, not treated as court findings.

health.name: World Health Organization — Gaza health-system assessment, 19 January 2025
health.limitations: Operational and damage assessment; not an attack-by-attack attribution or legality audit.

reproduction.name: UN Commission of Inquiry — Sexual and reproductive violence report, 13 March 2025
reproduction.locator: Commission report of March 2025, reproductive healthcare
reproduction.limitations: Reported destruction and consequences do not themselves establish deliberate embryo targeting.

structures.name: United Nations Satellite Centre — Gaza damage assessment, 8 July 2025
structures.limitations: Satellite damage assessment cannot determine military use or intention at each structure.

march_policy.name: Israeli Prime Minister’s Office — announcement, 2 March 2025
march_policy.locator: Decision to halt entry of goods and supplies; ceasefire-extension dispute
march_policy.basis: Primary statement of policy; corroborated by UN operational records
march_policy.limitations: Official rationale is evidence of a stated purpose, not proof that it was the sole purpose.

march_delivery.name: UN Office for Project Services — Gaza aid mechanism, March 2025 overview
march_delivery.limitations: The UN mechanism does not enumerate every possible stock or non-mechanism transfer.

famine.name: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification — Gaza analysis, August 2025
famine.limitations: Technical classification, disputed by Israel; classification is not a genocide judgment.

evacuation.name: Human Rights Watch — Hopeless, Starving, and Besieged, November 2024
evacuation.locator: Report methodology and findings on routes and safe areas
evacuation.limitations: Selected investigated cases; not an audit of every evacuation order.

detention.name: OHCHR — detention report release, 31 July 2024
detention.locator: Accounts of detention, torture and sexual violence
detention.basis: UN investigation, also reproduced by UNISPAL
detention.limitations: Reports concern detainees from Gaza and the West Bank, including East Jerusalem; do not generalize to all detainees or infer genocidal purpose automatically.

aims.name: Israeli Prime Minister’s Office — Statement of 6 January 2024
aims.limitations: Source URL contains 2023 but the statement is dated 6 January 2024; declared aims do not settle actual intent.

shifa.name: US State Department — briefing, 18 December 2023
shifa.locator: Exchange about al-Shifa command and control
shifa.basis: Primary public statement of an allied intelligence assessment
shifa.limitations: Underlying intelligence not fully public; neither a neutral court finding nor validation of every Israeli claim about hospitals.

tunnel.name: Associated Press — journalists visit tunnel below Gaza cemetery, 29 January 2024
tunnel.basis: Reporter observation on an Israeli-organized visit
tunnel.limitations: Access was military-controlled; observing a tunnel does not prove every claimed connection or justify the entire surrounding destruction.

resettlement.name: US Department of State — Press briefing, 3 January 2024
resettlement.limitations: US account of represented policy and ministerial statements; not proof of implementation.

coi.name: UN Commission of Inquiry — legal analysis, September 2025
coi.basis: Full 72-page primary report downloaded and read
coi.limitations: Commission applies reasonable grounds; no court verdict. Access constraints, overlapping underlying reports and contested inferences remain material.

amnesty.name: Amnesty International — December 2024 investigation
amnesty.locator: Intent to destroy; alternatives; selected 15 strikes
amnesty.basis: Primary explanation of Amnesty’s investigation and reasoning
amnesty.limitations: Not a court verdict; its treatment of disregard as evidence of intent must not be presented as a binding legal rule.

polio.name: World Health Organization — Completion of second polio vaccination round, 6 November 2024
polio.locator: WHO release, 6 November 2024, campaign coverage and pauses

relief_routes.name: World Food Programme — Gaza update, 17 May 2024
relief_routes.locator: World Food Programme update, May 2024, April deliveries

looting.name: OCHA — Humanitarian Situation Update 239, 19 November 2024
looting.locator: Convoy of 16 November: 97 of 109 truckloads lost
looting.limitations: Other updates report 98 trucks; do not quiz the disputed last digit or assume a specific armed group was responsible.

december.name: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification — Gaza analysis, December 2025
december.locator: December 2025 assessment; conditions observed in October–November
december.limitations: Improvement after ceasefire does not retrospectively disprove earlier famine; ongoing needs and access conditions remain.

warning.name: ICJ — order of 28 March 2024
warning.basis: Court’s contemporaneous warning and binding interim measures
warning.limitations: Interim decision, not a finding of genocidal intent; famine observation differs from a later technical classification.

ceasefire.name: OCHA — phase-one ceasefire response report, 17 March 2025
ceasefire.limitations: Observed improvement does not establish adequacy everywhere or explain every decision.

kitchen.name: Israel Defense Forces — World Central Kitchen investigation, 5 April 2024
kitchen.limitations: Military account of intent and discipline is not independent criminal adjudication.

medics.name: Sky News — verified medic footage, 5 April 2025
medics.locator: Video report and verification statement, 5 April 2025
medics.basis: Publisher verification of footage supplied by the Palestine Red Crescent Society
medics.limitations: Shows the signals and vehicles; does not itself settle all surrounding circumstances or wider intent.

power.name: OCHA — humanitarian response update, 2–15 March 2025
power.locator: Water, sanitation and hygiene: feeder line disconnected on 9 March
power.limitations: The line supplied a desalination plant; do not call it the only source of all drinking water in Gaza.

may_access.name: OCHA — Humanitarian Situation Update 292, 28 May 2025
may_access.limitations: Counts refer to different stages, not three independent measures of household consumption.

warrants.name: International Criminal Court — Reasons for warrants, 21 November 2024
warrants.limitations: Arrest warrants are not convictions or genocide findings; question is historical and does not assert their current procedural status.

rockets.name: Associated Press — Gaza rocket attack, 26 May 2024, via PBS
rockets.locator: Opening account of rocket barrage more than seven months into the war
rockets.basis: Contemporaneous Associated Press reporting, reproduced by PBS
rockets.limitations: Establishes a continuing armed capability, not military necessity for every Israeli action or absence of additional intent.
